items.title: Hack sent scam email to around 500 Hamilton County Democrats, local party says
items.summary: The Hamilton County Democratic Party was hacked this week, according to a party official. A bot from a New York server broke into one of the party’s shared email accounts to send a phishing scam to around 500 people, triggering alarm among local Democrats, said Hamilton County De

items.title: Housing affordability in Chattanooga falls as more homes hit the market
items.summary: Chattanooga homes are less affordable than they were this time last year, with nearly 20% more houses on the market, according to a recent report from local Realtors. The report from the Greater Chattanooga Realtors gave the local real estate market an affordability index of 84.
